changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionItem') BEGIN create table metrics.ExecutionItem ( ExecutionID bigint not null, ChangeType int not null, RowNumber int not null, Payload nvarchar(max) not null, [State] int not null, [Message] varchar(max) null, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricsExecutionItem] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( ExecutionID DESC, ChangeType DESC, RowNumber ASC ) ) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionItem') BEGIN DROP TABLE [metrics].[ExecutionItem] END
